title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(樋口正法研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Higuchi Masanori)
keywords: Magnetoencephalogram 2.Electroencephalogram 3.Brain signal analysis 4.Signal processing 5.AI and machine learning
educationalGoal: Humans are controlled by the brain information system composed of the peripheral and central nervous system. Students will study the mechanisms of this system by using magnetoencephalogram (MEG) and electroencephalogram (EEG). It is necessary to learn signal processing, data analysis methods, biometric measurements, sensory organ function, and central nervous system function. Students will learn a basic research method for brain science and engineering.
advice: Specific research subjects are as follows: 1. Design and construction of MEG and EEG database 2. Neural mechanism of video game addiction using MEG or EEG 3. Development of smart hearing aid using brain signals 4. Development of brain cloning technology using AI and machine learning 5. Prediction of human behavior using brain signals such as motor readiness potential 6. Mutual interaction between the EEGs of two subjects Students will research domestic and international literature, and find original research themes in consultation with supervisors.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of the human sensory system and central nervous system. Basic knowledge of signal processing and data analysis. Basic knowledge of physics such as electromagnetism.

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain the basic concept of psychophysical measurement.
Ability to explain the basic system for measuring biological signals.
Ability to find an original theme and research for facts.
Ability to read and understand English literature and explain it to others.
Ability to make a plan to solve unclear matters.
